ruleDefinitions.name: AWS IAM S3Browser User or AccessKey Creation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects S3 Browser utility creating IAM User or AccessKey. Note: Unmapped fields: eventSource, eventName, userAgent

sequences.query: (eventSource = "iam\.amazonaws\.com" AND (eventName = "CreateUser" OR eventName = "CreateAccessKey") AND userAgent = RGX(".*S3\\ Browser.*"))
